#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<long long> ways(n + 1, 0);
    vector<long long> next(n + 1, 0);
    long long tWays = 0;
    ways[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < 2 * n; i++) {
        next[0] = ways[1];
        next[n] = ways[n - 1];
        for (int k = 1; k < n; k++) {
            next[k] = (ways[k - 1] + ways[k + 1]) % MOD;
        }
        if (i % 2 == 1) {
            int limit = min(i, 2 * n - i);
            for (int k = 0; k <= limit; k++) {
                tWays = (tWays + next[k]) % MOD;
            }
        }
        ways = next;
    }
    cout << tWays << endl;
    return 0;
}
